CPI, AI Earnings, and PPI Take the Stage in Succession—Will $70K Be Tested Again? | HTX InsightsHomeCrypto News技术发展CPI, AI Earnings, and PPI Take...CPI, AI Earnings, and PPI Take the Stage in Succession—Will $70K Be Tested Again?AmbcryptoPublished on 2026-11-10Last updated on 2026-11-10AbstractAs of November 9, Bitcoin was reported at $74,322, down 1.85% in 24 hours. This week, U.S. CPI, AI-related corporate earnings, and PPI will be released successively. CME FedWatch at the time showed that the market-implied probability of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike in December had risen to 80.5%. The article focuses on whether BTC can reclaim recent buyers' average cost of $75,700, and whether $70,000 will be tested if it weakens.#BTC Price#BTC Regular Invest#BTC Surge#BTC PlungeKey Points

- Within four days, Bitcoin will face consumer inflation data, earnings from AI-related companies, and producer price data.

- Based on futures market pricing, a Federal Reserve rate hike in December was the more likely outcome at the time.

- Several past inflation reports offer a reference: when inflation exceeded expectations, Bitcoin saw notable pullbacks.

Three U.S. events this week could influence whether Bitcoin's decline deepens. Consumer inflation data will be released on Tuesday, AI-related corporate earnings will be concentrated on Thursday, and producer price data will come out on Friday.

According to BeInCrypto Markets data, as of press time, Bitcoin was at $74,322, down 1.85% in 24 hours. If inflation comes in above expectations, bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike in December could further increase. In the past, such expectations have put pressure on Bitcoin prices.






Will U.S. October CPI Make a December Rate Hike More Likely?

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the October Consumer Price Index (CPI) at 21:30 Beijing time on November 10.

According to the Associated Press, economists expect the U.S. inflation rate to rise from 3.7% in September to 3.9%.
